title: Overhead Console Controls and SOS Button
summary: Reviews focus on overhead console usability issues alongside informational mentions and questions about the SOS button.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unclear overhead light icons, difficulty telling buttons apart, and trouble switching the overhead lights on or off or reading the controls at night.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the SOS button’s purpose, use, or availability without a clear evaluative judgment, though one fragment notes appreciation that it is equipped.

limitations: The topic mixes two related but distinct subjects: overhead console usability complaints and non-evaluative SOS button mentions.
One negative fragment is incomplete and provides limited detail about the specific usability issue.
The sample is small, and several reviews are undetermined, limiting the strength of sentiment-specific detail.
